items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 21:1
items.html: You already know that the essence of Arich Anpin is only two heads, the aspect of male and female in the head, the male being called Galgalta and the female being called Sealed Brain, as in Answer 15, see there. But the male, which is the Galgalta, is itself divided into two heads, by reason of the correction of the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK of Tzelem with which the Mochin of Arich Anpin were corrected. For the first three of the Galgalta received the aspect of the correction of the MEM of Tzelem, over which the screen of the mouth of Atik cannot rule, but only over its lower seven. And the screen of Atik became the aspect of the firmament that separates between it and its lower seven, and this screen is called the membrane of the Avir, as is known.
